text:
anya: FYI I opened a batch of docs PRs for the site restructure. 10 PRs total — pages moved, examples split out, and a set of redirect rules. we need a safe merge playbook.
kevin: can you list the risky ones? previews or anchor changes?
anya: risky = anchors + redirects. low-risk = snippet fixes and example imports. TOC changes are medium risk.
sarah: saw one preview error already: `Anchor not found: #install-py` from PR 447 (moved install guide). looks like anchors changed when we reflowed headings.
docs-bot: PR 440 (examples/python) preview: success :white_check_mark:
oliver: I agree with split: 1) fix anchors inside moved pages, 2) merge snippet/example PRs, 3) merge redirects only after anchors are stable, 4) TOC/nav last.
lia: +1. Also propose a short merge window and a single person doing serial merges to avoid race conditions.
kevin: proposal: tomorrow 10:00-11:30 PT. oliver will merge and monitor redirects, sarah will be anchor on-call, anyone can revert.
nate: small automation idea — add a quick `anchor-check` job that scans redirects.yaml and fails if any target anchor is missing. I can draft it.
anya: good call. can we add a label `docs/fast-preview` to anchor fixes so previews get priority?
sarah: done for PRs 447 & 449. retriggering preview for 447.
docs-bot: rebuild started for PR 447 by @sarah — preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/pr-447 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: heads up — python examples import path is `redwood_inference.Client` in prod. one snippet still uses `redwood.Client`. I left a tiny patch on PR 440.
anya: let's hold redirects until all snippet fixes merged. redirects will 301 and could expose broken anchors publicly.
oliver: question: do we include historical blog slugs in the redirects? that could be additional risk.
anya: keep redirects minimal for this wave — canonical moves only. historical aliases later.
sarah: preview for 447 failed: missing `#install-py` anchor in `getting-started/install.md:line 78`. pushing patch to normalize heading to `## Install (Python)` -> anchor `install-python` to match redirects.
docs-bot: PR 447 preview: success :white_check_mark:
kevin: once anchors are green I can merge example PRs (440, 441). will watch for console errors from snippet imports.
ate: wrote `scripts/ci/anchor-check.sh` POC in PR 452. very small: grep redirects.yaml for anchors and verify they exist in docs/ tree. want review from @sarah.
sarah: quick review done, left one regex tweak. looks fine. this should prevent accidental redirect -> missing-anchor merges.
kevin: merging PR 440 (examples). tagging oliver to proceed with redirects after anchors are fully merged.
docs-bot: PR 440 merged by @kevin at 1796004480 :rocket:
lia: after redirects go in, i'll run linkinator across the staging site and produce a short report (broken links, 4xxs).
oliver: ready to merge redirect PR 445 once PRs 447/449/440 are merged. will merge with short delay and monitor logs for 5 minutes. rollback plan: push `redirects-rollback` to override rules if we see lots of 404s.
anya: can we add a `docs/meta-merge` branch option? advantage: one preview run and then bulk apply. downside: harder to cherry-pick back out. prefer serial merges for safety this time.
ate: reminder: CI is rate-limited. please avoid kicking more than 3 previews concurrently.
sarah: anchors look stable now. approved PRs 447 & 449.
oliver: merging redirects PR 445 now. watching.
docs-bot: PR 445 merged by @oliver at 1796004599 :rocket: — site reconfig published with new redirects
lia: linkinator pass on staging: 23 warnings, 0 critical broken anchors. will file follow-ups for the warnings.
kevin: thanks everyone. final step: TOC/nav PR 450 scheduled for 13:00 PT. anyone not comfortable with the new nav please say now.
anya: thanks team — add `docs/reorg-followup` label to any cleanup PRs so we can triage. really appreciate the quick reviews. :tada:
